consumer: The dialogue/condition lambda from conditional_t::set_has_item, which asks the yes/no 'does this actor have item X' that a mission/dialogue check evaluates.
scope: the character's own possession check (charges_of plus has_amount over the actor's carried inventory) — not a nearby-reachable or map-region scope
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::set_has_item — its body returns actor->charges_of(item_id) > 0 || actor->has_amount(item_id, 1), the engine-computed yes/no the check consumes.
divergence: Avatar carries a loaded gun whose magazine holds X but no loose X: has_amount/charges_of for X returns false (gun/magazine contents excluded), yet a re-derivation that recursed into the carried_items[] snapshot would wrongly report true.
